name: Document status code
description: Code specifying the status of a document.

values.name: Accepted
values.description: Accepted The specified document is accepted.

values.name: Accompanying goods
values.description: Accompanying goods Notice that a specific document will be accompanying the goods.

values.name: Conditionally accepted
values.description: Conditionally accepted The specified document is conditionally accepted.

values.name: To arrive by separate EDI message
values.description: To arrive by separate EDI message Notice that a specific document/message will be transmitted via a separate EDI message.

values.name: Information only
values.description: Information only Notice that the specific document or message is for information only.

values.name: To arrive by manual means
values.description: To arrive by manual means Notice that a specific document or message will not be sent via EDI.

values.name: To be raised and sent
values.description: To be raised and sent Request for a specific message to be formatted and transmitted or a request for a specific document to be raised and sent.

values.name: Rejected
values.description: Rejected The specified document is rejected.

values.name: To be printed
values.description: To be printed The document or message is to be printed.

values.name: Document currently valid
values.description: Document currently valid Specific document is currently valid.

values.name: Document not available
values.description: Document not available Specified document is not available.

values.name: Document exhausted by declaration and attached
values.description: Document exhausted by declaration and attached Customs declaration to which the document is related completed or exhaust the allowance stated on the document. The document is attached to the Customs declaration.

values.name: Document not exhausted by declaration and attached
values.description: Document not exhausted by declaration and attached Customs declaration to which the document is related does not complete or exhaust the allowance stated on the document . The document is not attached to the declaration but has already been lodged in the Customs station.

values.name: Document exhausted by declaration and previously lodged
values.description: Document exhausted by declaration and previously lodged Customs declaration to which the document is related completed or exhaust the allowance stated on the document. The usage of the document is complete. The document is not attached to the declaration but has already been lodged in the Customs station.

values.name: Document not exhausted by declaration and previously lodged
values.description: Document not exhausted by declaration and previously lodged Customs declaration to which the document is related does not complete or exhaust the allowance stated on the document. The document can continue to be used for future declarations until the allowance is exhausted. The document is not attached to the declaration but has already been lodged in the Customs station.

values.name: Document not attached
values.description: Document not attached Specified document is not or cannot be attached.

values.name: Document with the goods
values.description: Document with the goods Document not attached to the Customs declaration but is attached to the goods.

values.name: Document attached, to be returned after endorsement
values.description: Document attached, to be returned after endorsement Specified document is attached to the Customs declaration and will be required to be returned to the declarant after Customs endorsement.

values.name: Document applied for
values.description: Document applied for Application has been submitted for that document.

values.name: Received for shipment
values.description: Received for shipment Indicates that the document has legal validity from the date of receival of the cargo.

values.name: Shipped on board
values.description: Shipped on board Indicates that the document has legal validity from the date that cargo is loaded on board a vessel.

values.name: Status 0
values.description: Status 0 Message is at status 0.

values.name: Status 1
values.description: Status 1 Message is at status 1.

values.name: Status 2
values.description: Status 2 Message is at status 2.

values.name: Message under development
values.description: Message under development Message is under development.

values.name: Document not freighted
values.description: Document not freighted Document not to include freight figures.

values.name: Document freighted
values.description: Document freighted Document to include freight figures.

values.name: Archived
values.description: Archived The document or message has been archived.

values.name: Provisional
values.description: Provisional The document or message has no official status.

values.name: Documents enclosed in the first transmission
values.description: Documents enclosed in the first transmission The documents are enclosed in the first transmission.

values.name: Documents enclosed in the second transmission
values.description: Documents enclosed in the second transmission The documents are enclosed in the second transmission.

values.name: Document not required, waiver issued
values.description: Document not required, waiver issued The document is not required, waiver of requirement has been issued.

values.name: Already on file with receiver of this message
values.description: Already on file with receiver of this message The document is already on file with the party receiving the message.

values.name: Retained by sender of this message, or by sender's agent or
values.description: Retained by sender of this message, or by sender's agent or representative The document is in the possession of the sender or sender's agent or representative.

values.name: Document incomplete
values.description: Document incomplete The document is incomplete.

values.name: Document previously submitted
values.description: Document previously submitted The document has already been submitted.

values.name: Document complete
values.description: Document complete The document is complete.
